question: What identity and power are attributed to Phetkāriṇī in this tantra?
premises: The speaker declares Phetkāriṇī in this tantra.
Phetkāriṇī is described as the giver of desired accomplishment.
The declaration is made by the speaker as an authoritative teaching.
inference: Phetkāriṇī is declared in this tantra to be the giver of desired accomplishment.
plain_english: In this tantra, I have declared that Phetkāriṇī is the giver of desired accomplishment.
